evidence: 논문 전문 인용(§ Abstract·Data 서술 전체): 'The effectiveness of the stock selection strategy is validated in Chinese stock market in both statistical and practical aspects.' / 'The training dataset is constructed from Chinese stock data ranging from 2012.08.08 to 2013.02.01 and the testing dataset is constructed from 2013.02.04 to 2013.03.08.' / 'Say there are M stock candidates and T days historical stock data.' — 이 세 문장이 유니버스에 관해 논문이 말하는 전부이며, 필터·종목수·거래소·제외 규칙은 어디에도 없다(jina 프록시로 전 키워드 재검색 0건 확인).
